subject: AegisHealth exec workshop — hybrid SG / US dates, travel & visa holds
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 09:07:00 -0700
Subject: AegisHealth exec workshop — proposed hybrid dates and needs

Team,

Following our pipeline review, AegisHealth (Priya/Tom copied below) are leaning toward a 2-day executive workshop in Singapore with parallel virtual sessions for the US leadership. Proposed onsite dates: Tue–Wed, 21–22 June (SG).

Immediate asks so we can block travel and start visa support:
- Confirm final workshop dates (Aegis asked to hold 21–22 June).
- I/O: names and titles of attending execs (who needs international travel).
- Visa flags: who requires business visa support / invitation letters / consulate interview windows.
- Travel windows: preferred arrival/departure windows for execs (any early arrival for prep/rehearsal).
- Hotel preference and any corporate rate restrictions (they asked for Marina Bay area or equivalent).
- AV & room layout needs (U-shape vs theatre), in-case live broadcast to US is needed.
- Catering dietary restrictions.

I've attached a short draft scope to get procurement started (draft-scope.pdf).

Please reply with the attendee list and visa flags by EOD Wednesday so we can lock hotel blocks and get draft invites out. Aditya, please lead the customer-facing confirmations. Marissa / Jonas — ops + travel. Rachel — logistics and AV.

Thanks,
Kimberly

--
Kimberly Park
Head of Customer Programs, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.ai

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Lee <tom.lee@aegishealth.com>, Priya Sharma <priya.sharma@aegishealth.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 11:32:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AegisHealth exec workshop — proposed hybrid dates and needs

Tom / Priya — thanks for the quick chat last week.

We can hold 21–22 June for the onsite in Singapore and run parallel virtual sessions for NA leadership the same days in a late-morning SG time slot (to align with US early morning). To keep momentum I'd propose the following mutual action plan (attached MAP-Aegis.xlsx):
- 5/12: final attendee list + speaker roles (your side)
- 5/14: visa flags and any passport copies for invitation letters
- 5/18: hotel block preference + confirm rooming list
- 6/14: final run-of-show + AV run-through (1 hour)

Two quick Qs:
1) Do you expect any execs to require visa invitation letters from us? If yes, we should start the consulate paperwork now — typical lead times ~3–6 weeks depending on nationality.
2) Will there be any IP-sensitive material requiring a private room and non-recording?

We will get preliminary calendar holds out once we have a firm attendee list. Attaching the MAP for visibility.

Best,
Aditya
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.ai

Subject: Re: AegisHealth exec workshop — proposed hybrid dates and needs

Hi all,

21–22 June works for the exec team. Quick update from our side:
- Confirmed attendees: CEO Karen Holt, CTO Rajesh Iyer, CPO Lisa Gomez, VP Ops Michael Tan (total 4 execs).
- Visa: Rajesh (Indian passport) and Michael (Bangladeshi passport) will need formal invitation letters and expedited consulate appointments if possible. Karen and Lisa are OK.
- Arrival: Rajesh will arrive 20 June afternoon for prep; Karen will arrive evening 20 June. Others will arrive 21 June morning.
- Hotel: they prefer Marina Bay Sands but business suite availability is limited; an equivalent downtown property near Raffles Place is acceptable.
- AV: we will require a small private room for the CEO briefing (non-recording) and a larger break-out in the afternoon for a hands-on demo that will be streamed to the US.

I can share passport photocopies under secure channel once you confirm the invitation letter wording and recipient emails. Also please send the draft agenda for any pre-reads.

Thanks,
Tom
Director, Strategic Accounts — AegisHealth
tom.lee@aegishealth.com

Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 10:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AegisHealth exec workshop — proposed hybrid dates and needs

Thanks Tom / Team — capturing ops items and next steps below.

Hotel & travel
- Will propose two hotel blocks: Marina Bay alternative (The Fullerton / Pan Pacific) + a backup downtown property. Draft room block spreadsheet attached (hotel-blocks.xlsx).
- Vendor: AeroTransit for executive airport transfers — they can provide meet+greet and extended waiting windows for early arrivals.

AV & rooms
- AVWorks (local) can handle dual-streaming + private recording policies. For the CEO private briefing we will request a non-record flag and separate access control.
- Room layouts: Day 1 (exec strategy) — boardroom U-shape (max 20). Day 2 (demo) — theatre + hands-on pods (demo stations x6).

Visa & invitation letters
- Aditya / Kimberly: please confirm exact invite recipients and full legal names as they appear on passports by 5/14. We will route invitation letters and request expedited appointment slots via our travel partner.

Calendar holds & next steps
- I'll publish tentative calendar holds for 2100–0400 UTC (corresponds to morning SG / early US window) once we have the attendee list.
- Ops will share vendor contact details and a single shared folder for confidential passport scans (SFTP link).

Attachments: hotel-blocks.xlsx (room block proposal).

Marissa
Senior Programs Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
